title: AgentRollback-Eval: Measuring Whether Agent Frameworks Support Safe Checkpointing and Rollback

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tests whether a fundamental safety mechanism (rollback) is available in current agent frameworks. Useful infrastructure audit. The causal chain to impact is: identify gaps, motivate framework developers to add rollback support.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Implementing checkpointing in 4 different agent frameworks requires deep familiarity with each framework's internals. State serialization and restoration is non-trivial engineering. Beyond beginner level.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 4 frameworks x checkpoint implementation + 20 tasks with mid-task failures + three metrics per framework. Too many moving parts for 30hrs. Could be scoped to 1-2 frameworks.
